title: Change impact analysis
summary: Prove the blast radius of a change from real dependencies before implementation, then reconcile the planned impact against the actual diff.

provenance.notes: Keeps ECC's six questions (code, data, interfaces, tests, docs, release) and the rule that unverified consumers are reported as unverified.

inputs.name: change
inputs.description: The planned change in one paragraph.

inputs.name: diff
inputs.description: The actual diff, when reconciling after implementation.

outputs.name: impact-report
outputs.description: Affected code, data, interfaces, tests, docs and release steps, each with evidence.

outputs.name: drift
outputs.description: Differences between planned impact and the actual diff.

workflow.step: List direct callers and importers of each changed symbol using search over real imports and calls.
workflow.check: No dependency is inferred from a directory name.

workflow.step: Check data and interfaces: persisted formats, serialization, schemas, routes, CLI flags, message shapes and who consumes each.
workflow.check: Each consumer is named, or listed as unverified.

workflow.step: Name the tests that should prove the change and the existing tests likely to break; name the missing ones.
workflow.check: Test names come from files you opened.

workflow.step: State rollout and rollback: ordering, compatibility window and anything irreversible.
workflow.check: A change with irreversible effects has an explicit recovery statement or is reported as blocked.

workflow.step: After implementation, compare the diff with the plan and report scope drift and consumers still unverified.

constraints: Read-only analysis; do not run migrations or deploy anything.
Mark every unproven consumer as unverified instead of omitting it.
An impact report does not authorize widening the task's allowed files.

examples.title: Error type change
examples.situation: A function starts returning a wrapped error.
examples.guidance: Search for errors.Is and equality checks against the old value, list each caller, and flag the ones that would stop matching.

verification: Every affected item cites a file; unknowns are labelled unverified.
Post-change reconciliation lists any file touched that the plan did not predict.

task.text: Plan a breaking change to the public interface and identify the blast radius and consumers.
Review this cross-module refactor for affected callers and rollback.
Apply the breaking change to the public interface.
Plan the copy for the welcome email.
